definitions.delta: Multi minus single. Failed/invalid outputs count as zero.
definitions.decomposition: delta = paired_output_effect + unpaired_success_effect. The first term uses cases valid in both; the second uses cases valid in only one.
definitions.properties: Top-level fields except resourceType/id; arrays and objects count once.
definitions.scaffold: Occurrences of status, code and subject. These repeat with resource splitting.
definitions.value_nodes: value[x] fields at resource and component levels; not a clinical fact count.
definitions.exact_duplicates: Identical JSON resources after removing only the root id; flags structural repetition, not proven clinical duplication.
definitions.labels: Normalized code.text string presence; different strings may describe the same fact.
definitions.review: Extremes plus seeded random cases in each direction/type. Exploratory, not representative.

limitations: No semantic validation. An absent field/label is not proof of missing information. More resources, fields or value nodes do not establish better clinical coverage.
